title: Style-Locked Asset Generation Orchestrator
objective: Provide provider-neutral, deterministic style-locked asset-generation job preparation over governed art-bible/style/reference manifests while preserving owning content/ARI authority, cost and routing controls, and keeping generated assets as candidates until owning workflows accept them.

scope.purpose: Prepare provider-neutral style-locked asset-generation jobs without allowing any generation engine or provider to become canonical source authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative governed style/reference inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable provider-neutral generation jobs with stable cache/provenance and bounded routing/budget/review behavior while generated outputs remain candidate assets until owning workflows accept them and invalid owner/reference/provider/budget states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-08 exact-tree publication. PCA-08 satisfies the PCA-08 prerequisite in MSAS but does not unlock MSAS because PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER remain required; MCS and MCCS likewise remain blocked by PCA-15 and the barrier. No interstitial rotation/studio start is newly unlocked by PCA-08, so PCA-09 is the lawful next PCA item.
PCA-09 is selected only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it.
PCA-01..08 remain completed foundations and must not be silently reimplemented or weakened.
PCA-09 generation providers and engines are replaceable executors only and may not become canonical source authority.
Generated outputs remain candidates until the owning content/resource workflows accept them; ARI remains the governed resource identity/provenance/rights path for media resources.

Detailed PCA-09 art-bible/style/reference owner seams, provider adapters, routing/budget controls and candidate-acceptance seams are deferred to governed-start targeted loading rather than guessed at selection time.
PCA-10+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start PCA-09. Do not implement PCA-09 while selected_not_started.
